slides.text: Pick the tool by the job. Not the buzzword.
slides.voiceover_text: Owners keep asking me which tool to buy. Wrong question. Pick by the job, not by the buzzword on the sales page.

slides.text: Name the exact task. The hour you want back
slides.voiceover_text: One. Name the exact task. Not we want to be more efficient. The actual job. Drafting intake replies. Summarising calls. Booking consultations.

slides.text: Test it on your real cases, not a demo
slides.voiceover_text: Two. Test it on your real cases. Not the polished demo. Throw your messiest enquiry at it. See what comes back.

slides.text: Measure whether your team will actually use it
slides.voiceover_text: Three. Measure adoption. The clever tool your team won't use is worse than the boring tool they will.

slides.text: Job first. Test second. Adoption third.
slides.voiceover_text: Job first. Real test second. Adoption third. The buzzword on the box doesn't matter.
